abbott_hypothesis_en: 1   ἔπος, -εος (-ους), τό     [in LXX: Za 7:3, Si 44:5 * ;]     a word: ὡς ἔ. εἰπεῖν (cl.), so to speak: He 7:9.†   SYN.: λόγος, reasoned speech; ῥῆμα, mere articulated utterance; ἔ., the articulated expression of a thought
